title: MTI Corporation
content: MTI Corporation is a U.S.-owned materials science equipment supplier serving laboratories and pilot-scale development programs. Its portfolio includes furnaces, gloveboxes, presses, coating systems, substrates, and related equipment used in advanced materials R&D. MTI is relevant to aerogel process development teams that need broad laboratory infrastructure for precursor handling, thermal treatment, and materials prototyping.
